mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, available_points, frozen_points, version, create_time, update_time FROM ai_point_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_point_account SET available_points = available_points + #{points}, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{accountId}
